summary: Correct CC-002 authority before adding a governed wheel derivation.
why: OVR-000065 authorizes the deterministic ANTLR build but not transformation of a published wheel, a local derived version, a derivative-input area, or v3 derivation evidence. CC-002 stays implementation-owned, but its next active authorization must state the exact allowlist, double-transform gate, ownership, runtime exclusions, and stop conditions.
